in_sanskrit.name: देवनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: देव (Deva) - god, नाथ (Natha) - lord, देवनाथ (Devanatha) - god's possession

in_hindi.meaning: देव (Deva) - god, नाथ (Nath) - lord, देवनाथ (Devanath) - देव का नाथ (Deva ka Natha) - God's possession

in_tamil.name: தேவநாத
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேவ (Thevam) - god, நாத்திர (Nathir) - lord, தேவநாத (Thevanatham) - தேவன் இன்திருக்குள் (Thevan inthirukkul) - God's presence

in_telugu.name: దేశనాధ
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేశ (Dhesh) - god, నాధ (Nadh) - lord, దేశనాధ (Dheshanadh) - దేశమీదేశ్ (Dheshameesha) - God's lord

in_marathi.name: Debnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Debts
in_marathi.long_meaning: Debnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Debnath is the deity who frees us from our debts, both material and spiritual. He is a form of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and transformation.
